text:
maria: Heads up - AWS Marketplace settlement shows a negative adjustment for partner ACME. Invoice ACME-2026-03 has a -$4,200 credit line. Looks like duplicate UsageRecords during the US-EAST-1 incident window. Can someone take a look?
aws-billing-bot: Automated scan: 2 duplicate UsageRecord entries detected for product p-0abc123 between 2026-03-12T02:00:00Z and 2026-03-12T02:23:00Z. Related AWS transaction IDs: tx-9876, tx-9877.
sam: I can own this - filing with AWS marketplace billing now. @maria please attach any S3 exports you have for that date range.
paul: We got an email from the partner saying their internal invoice didn't show a credit, so they're confused. They asked if this was a downstream reversal or an AWS credit.
rachel: I'm holding the GL entry until we confirm. Created a placeholder journal JE-2026-03-ACME-HOLD for -4200.
kevin: FYI our ingestion pipeline logged a retry around 02:12Z due to a timeout. Might be where duplicates reappeared.
sam: Uploading quick grep from the AWS export I grabbed:```csv
2026-03-12T02:11:02Z,p-0abc123,UsageRecord,tx-9876,100
2026-03-12T02:11:05Z,p-0abc123,UsageRecord,tx-9876,100
2026-03-12T02:15:30Z,p-0abc123,UsageRecord,tx-9877,220
2026-03-12T02:15:33Z,p-0abc123,UsageRecord,tx-9877,220
```
paul: That CSV makes it clear - duplicates are literal repeats with same tx ids. Partner ops will ask ACME for any reconciliation on their end but they likely won't have anything.
sam: AWS case opened: case 1234567890. Requesting consolidation of duplicate UsageRecords and issuance of a Marketplace credit against partner account. I'll paste updates.
aws-billing-bot: Case 1234567890 status: "UNDER_REVIEW". Expected response time ~48 hours.
maria: Please flag for month-end close impact. If AWS won't confirm before close, we need a reserve note and an adjustment plan for next month.
sam: AWS responded - they confirmed duplicate ingestion due to a routing retry and issued a Partner Credit of $4,200 dated 2026-03-20. Portal shows adjustment type: PartnerAdjustment, reference PA-20260320-ACME.
paul: Copy - we'll reflect the credit on the partner invoice and notify ACME. Draft message to partner: "AWS issued a Marketplace credit (PA-20260320-ACME) for $4,200 related to duplicate usage on 2026-03-12. We'll mirror this on your March invoice."
rachel: Removed JE-2026-03-ACME-HOLD and created JE-2026-03-ACME-CREDIT referencing PA-20260320-ACME. Posting after I get the screenshot of the AWS credit.
kevin: Pushed a small fix to ingestion to dedupe by tx id and timestamp window. PR: refs/ingest/dedupe-2026-03. Will monitor next deployment.
maria: Great - once you have AWS screenshot, tag me and I'll approve the GL post. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
paul: Notifying ACME now. cc @maria @rachel.
sam: Closing thread; will reopen if AWS changes the credit. Case 1234567890 -> CLOSED with resolution code: "Duplicate UsageRecord consolidation".
paul: ACME acknowledged and asked for a short note for their finance team. Sending now. :white_check_mark:
